Coming over from reddit and I have a few questions

Modlog! With any subverse, you can check deleted comments and discussions. Add /modlog/deleted or /modlog/deletedcomments at the end of the subverse to check either. It would look something like this: https://voat.co/v/starcraft/modlog/deletedcomments

That is the main, but there is also a limit on how many subs a user can mod, at 10 subs per user.

And lastly, if a sub mod is inactive, there is a subverse called /v/subverserequest that can shift that sub to a user that wants to use the sub. This helps stop sub squatting from inactive members.
